To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

NIR spectra of American ginseng, Chinese ginseng, and their mixture can be successfully used to develop calibration models to predict their total main ginsensoside contents, and OSC preprocessing method is more effective than routine methods to develop calibration models for the prediction of total main ginsensoisde contents.
NIR spectra can be used to predict the total main ginesenoside contents in American ginseng, and the prediction accuracy can reach 4.07.
NIR spectroscopy can be applied to fast determine the contents of main ginsenoside in American ginseng,Chinese ginseng and their products.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the potential of NIR spectroscopy for rapid analysis of the total main ginesonides contents in Chinese and American ginsen.
the application of OSC in NIR spectroscopy for rapid analysis of total main ginsengs in ginseng.
the potential of NIR spectroscopy as an alternative tool for the determination of the total main ginesosides contents in ginseng.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NIR spectroscopy has great potential for fast determination of total main ginsengs contents in Chinese gingseng and American gingseng.
OSC can be a powerful preprocessing method in near infrared spectroscopy for ginsenoside determination in Chinese ginsen and American ginsen.
OSC can be used as an effective preprocessing method to enhance the prediction ability of the PLS models for the determination of the total main ginesosides contents in Chinese and American ginsens.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NIR spectroscopy can be used as a rapid and accurate method for determination of total main ginsengosides contents in American ginseng,Chinese ginseng,and other ginseng species.
NIR spectroscopy is a promising technique for fast determination of ginsenosides in ginseng.
NIR spectroscopy is a promising tool for quality control and rapid analysis of ginseng products in the future.
